name: syn_admissions_offer
target_definition: target_offer = 1 if the application received an offer (decision ADMITTED or ADMITTED_DECLINED).

excluded_leakage_columns.decision_date: date of the decision (after the prediction point)
excluded_leakage_columns.student_id: exists only for applicants who enrolled (reveals the outcome)

population: Decided applications for entry terms 2016FA-2026FA (PENDING and 2027SP excluded).
split: Chronological by entry term: test = entry terms of academic year 2025/26 onwards (2025FA, 2026SP, 2026SU, 2026FA); train = earlier entry terms; test-period applicants removed from training.
notes: Unique applicants per entry term = applications per entry term (no applicant applied twice for the same term).
